explanation: Dynamite made nitroglycerine, discovered by Ascanio Sobrero in 1847, far safer to handle by soaking it into a crumbly, porous earth called kieselguhr.

claims.text: Nobel did not invent gunpowder, nitroglycerine or TNT.
Dynamite is nitroglycerine soaked into kieselguhr, a porous earth, which makes it much safer to handle.
Alfred Nobel's fortune funded the Nobel Prizes, set up by his will.
